terms.history-carry privilege: authority borrowed from past-search or memory carryover rather than from the present query basis alone.
terms.personal-context privilege: authority borrowed from connected Gmail, Photos, saved memories, or other private context surfaces rather than from public evidence.
terms.profile privilege: authority borrowed from a surface mainly because it matches or invokes a user profile rather than because the public basis itself changed.
